GoGreen.facts: The package expressly finances repairs after natural disasters and revises multifamily retrofit financing. Multifamily regulations were incorporated into the Business program in 2024. Changes cover project eligibility, enrollment timing, security interests and loss-reserve contributions.
GoGreen.operating_connection: Selecting and funding a qualifying multifamily energy repair/retrofit or disaster reconstruction; compare eligible scope, financing availability and project timing when recommending the repair plan.
GoGreen.selection: Conditional financing-source inclusion, tied to choosing this program; not a general residential obligation.

OEHHA.facts: The agency identifies 1-BP solvent cleaners and adhesive sprays and DEA use in producing substances used in liquid laundry and dishwashing detergents. The proposed DEA level is dermal only; NSRLs supply optional safe harbors for exposure-warning decisions.
OEHHA.operating_connection: Conditional chemical-product use and resulting exposure during unit cleaning or repair. The identified uses map directly to those operations; actual chemical identity and exposure remain application facts. This is not inclusion merely because a property could contain a chemical.
OEHHA.limits: Do not equate DEA with cocamide DEA or claim all detergents contain DEA. The ISOR establishes source-selection relevance, not approved threshold status.
